# Glossary

<!-- Generated by archdoc glossary. Edit the files under term/ instead. -->

## Environment version

A counter on each environment that goes up whenever what its flags evaluate to changes, and from which the bulk evaluation ETag is built.

## Owner

The Kit user a project belongs to; the only one who can see or change it, and whose webhook subscriptions receive its events.

## SDK key

A Sanctum token owned by an environment, holding only the ofrep:evaluate ability, which an OpenFeature OFREP provider sends to evaluate that environment's flags.

## Serve

What a rule or a default gives: one variant, or a split across variants by weight.

## Settings

A flag's configuration in one environment: whether it is enabled, its off variant, its default serve and its ordered rules.

## Split

A serve that divides subjects between variants by weight, in hundredths of a percent, using a bucket computed from the flag key and the targeting key.
